scope.original: Eight indexed Barcelona-area cinemas. Cinema-level public-source dossier joined to 85-room technical and image catalogues. Broad research snapshot, not an exhaustive registry or full platform review archive.

scope.cultural_gap_followup: 15 cultural screening expansion profiles and four existing-cinema gap updates; primary screening qualification remains pending for two cultural leads.
scope.current: All 38 current local directory entries plus 21 researched expansion candidates. Earlier scope keys describe historical research batches, not current exclusions.

conventions.ownership: Operator, company behind a website, group parent and property owner are separately scoped. No claim of cadastral or beneficial-owner verification.
conventions.history: Predecessor venue, brand project, physical cinema, multiplex conversion and refurbishment dates are distinct.
conventions.reviews: Opinion samples do not certify equipment, capacities, accessibility or current policy. No representative sentiment estimate.
conventions.images: Source and room certainty retained in auditorium-images.json. Reference access does not establish reuse rights.
conventions.prices: Old review prices are not current tariffs. Performance-specific prices not normalised.
conventions.access: No inaccessible endpoint was bypassed. Previously collected public data reused where a later request was blocked.
